Which word belongs to this topic?
Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

city — a large town. Example: I live in a big city.
town — a place smaller than a city. Example: My town is small.
museum — a place with objects to look at. Example: First, visit the museum.
park — a public green place in a town. Example: There are two parks near my building.
street — a road with houses or shops. Example: The streets are clean.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• First, visit the ...
• Then walk along ...
• Finally, relax in the park.
• How do I get there?
• Enjoy your day!

Grammar focus: There is / There are for places in town.
Give a city tour in order: First, visit the museum. Then walk along the main street. Finally, relax in the park. Use imperatives and there is.

Reading: read the text and answer the questions.
My city tour: first, visit the museum in the town centre. Then walk along the main street to the park. Finally, have lunch near the station. The city is small but beautiful.
Listening: listen to the dialogue and answer the questions.
A: What can I visit in one day? B: First the museum, then the park. A: How do I get there? B: Walk along this street.
